# Model specification: barometer 1.1.0

Pressure sensors backed by the common sensor source: command-based MS5611 and FIFO-based ICP-201xx.

## Features

| Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|
| base | PROM, conversions, ADC read. |
| icp201xx | Identity, OTP boot, operation modes and the 16-pair pressure/temperature FIFO. |

## Terms

| Term | Kind | Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| reset | control | base | Reset command; reloads the PROM. |
| prom | data | base | Calibration words C1..C6 and the CRC word (PROM read commands). |
| convert_pressure | control | base | Starts a D1 conversion at an oversampling ratio. |
| convert_temperature | control | base | Starts a D2 conversion at an oversampling ratio. |
| adc_read | data | base | 24-bit result of the last completed conversion (0 if none). |
| conversion_time | status | base | Datasheet conversion time per oversampling ratio. |
| mode_select | control | icp201xx | ICP-201xx measurement configuration, continuous/standby state and FIFO readout order. |
| fifo_pair | data | icp201xx | One signed 20-bit pressure and temperature pair at its own 40 Hz sample time. |
| fifo_fill | status | icp201xx | ICP-201xx empty/full flags and fill level from zero through 16 pairs. |

## Behaviour rules

| Rule | Feature | Rule text |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-BARO-B001 | base | After reset the PROM holds fixed calibration words whose CRC-4 (AN520) is valid (ADV-CHIP-MS5611-001). |
| ADV-BARO-B002 | base | A pressure p and temperature T from the sensor source read, through D1 and D2, as raw values that the datasheet's first-order compensation with the PROM coefficients turns back into p and T within one count (the model inverts the compensation). |
| ADV-BARO-B003 | base | adc_read returns the result of the last conversion only after its conversion_time has passed; read earlier (or without a conversion) it returns 0, as the datasheet states. |
| ADV-BARO-B004 | base | The same commands work on SPI and on I2C (bus binding from the Devicetree). |
| ADV-BARO-B005 | icp201xx | ICP-201xx identity, revision-dependent OTP boot and Mode2 configuration follow ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-001 through -003. |
| ADV-BARO-B006 | icp201xx | The 16-pair FIFO keeps its oldest pairs when full, advances after a complete pair burst, and implements partial reads and flush as ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-004 specifies. |
| ADV-BARO-B007 | icp201xx | Each pair inverts the datasheet pressure and temperature conversions from the value source at the pair's sample time as ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-005 specifies. |
| ADV-BARO-B008 | icp201xx | FIFO production is lazy at register access and a 30 Hz PX4 drain observes the complete 40 Hz input sequence as ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-006 specifies. |
| ADV-BARO-B009 | icp201xx | Register observations are deterministic except for the documented completion of a FIFO fetch (ADV-CHIP-ICP201XX-007). |

**Timing.** MS5611 conversions complete conversion_time after the command. ICP-201xx Mode2 pairs occur every 25 ms and are materialized lazily when the FIFO is observed.

**Out of scope.** second-order temperature compensation effects, noise (from the source values)
